input: Schick et al. (2023) list Toolformer's limitations: it cannot use tools in a chain because API calls for each tool are generated independently, it cannot use a tool interactively (for example browse search results), it is sample-inefficient for some tools, and it does not consider the cost of making an API call. Critique a claim that Toolformer is a general tool-using agent able to chain tools and refine its searches.
source: Schick et al. 2023, Limitations (chunks schick2023-033, schick2023-034)
